column1: # What tools/survey/survey.py counts: one row per line and range of settings, with the stacks to
# count at each.
#   line      text, image, audio, video, models or binary
#   settings  the line's options as for `sieve filters` (without the dashes), each one value, a list
#             a,b,c, a range lo..hi (every integer), lo..hi:step (adding step) or lo..hi*k
#             (multiplying by k); key==other takes another setting's value (height==width).
#             Every combination of the settings is counted.
#   stacks    each   every filter the line offers, on its own, at its defaults
#             all    every filter the line offers, together
#             a-v1+b-v1          those filters together
#             a-v1[p=1,2;q=3]    a filter at each setting (lists and ranges as above), and with + too
# line    | settings                                                    | stacks
text      | length=8..32*2 alphabet=lower27                            | each, all
text      | length=64..1024*4 alphabet=lower27                         | each, all
text      | length=3200 alphabet=lower27                               | each
image     | width=5..10 height==width palette=mono                     | each, all
image     | width=8,16 height==width palette=ega16,rgb332,rgb24         | each, all
image     | width=10 height=10 palette=ega16                            | palette-size-v1[colours=2,4,8,16], row-runs-v1[changes=0..4]
video     | width=5 height=5 frames=2..8:2 palette=mono,ega16           | each, all
audio     | note-set=notes104 length=4..16:4                            | each, all
audio     | note-set=notes2 voices=1,2 length=4,8,16                    | each, all
audio     | note-set=notes3 longest=4,16 levels=1,8 length=2,4,8        | each, all
audio     | note-set=pcm bits=8 length=100..800*2                       | each, all
audio     | note-set=pcm bits=16 channels=1,2 length=100,8000           | sound-peak-v1
audio     | note-set=pcm bits=8 length=400                              | sound-step-v1[percent=10,25,50,75], sound-peak-v1[percent=25,50,90]
models    | vertices=4,8 faces=4,12 coords=16                           | each, all
binary    | length=8..64*2                                              | each
